identity.description: An attacker attempts to clear shell history by executing commands that delete command history files in Windows. Cortex should detect this behavior as an uncommon attempt to clear shell history. This activity is often used to evade detection by removing traces of commands executed.

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of cmd.exe with deletion of history file

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Shell History Clearing
biocs.description: Detection of process attempting to delete or clear shell history files in Windows
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'del' and action_command_line contains 'ConsoleHost_history.txt'
